findings.summary: The new NotificationJob invariant cancels quiet-hours jobs at delivery, but the requirement and criterion say such reminders must be deferred and delivered when quiet hours end.
findings.evidence: NotificationJob: "A job whose delivery time falls inside the owner's quiet hours is cancelled at delivery" vs S.webapp.prompts: "A reminder that falls inside the owner's quiet hours must be deferred to the end of the quiet period" and criterion: "A reminder due during quiet hours is delivered when they end"

findings.summary: NotificationPreferences is described as editing quiet hours but only has a reads link to Account and no affordance that writes quietHours.
findings.evidence: description: External reminder opt-in and quiet hours ... links: - { rel: reads, to: entity.Account }
